## Family Stories

John Charles Dillon married Elizabeth Beattie Telfer on 18th December 1856. The wedding took place in the home of Elizabeth's uncle, Francis Telfer, at "Macoota" — Section 6146, Chain of Ponds in the Hundred of Para Wirra. John's occupation was listed as "Stock-keeper" and his residence as "Wall — Hundred of Murray". The witnesses were Elizabeth's brothers James and Robert Telfer, and the officiating minister was William Vercoe.

John was the son of John Boswell Dillon, who was a descendant of Viscount Dillon of Ireland. Early in their married life, John and Elizabeth had a property on the Yorke Peninsula, later moved to Tea Tree Gully, and eventually settled at Millbrook.

John was also a trustee of the Church of Christ at Chain of Ponds (the Kersbrook area), listed alongside Francis Telfer on the 1862 land transfer deed from Thomas Scott.

*(From the Borders to the Bush, pp. 29, 214)*

*Note: Much of the narrative about John and Elizabeth's life together is told through Elizabeth's story.*
